decided_by: Kate and Zach, 2026-10-22 (review of KB v0.2, 2026-10-21)

hook_identifiers.true_when: a mana ability of that permanent whose cost includes {T} resolves and produces mana (CR 106.12, 106.12a-b, 605)
not_true_when: the permanent is tapped to pay crew or station
the permanent is tapped by an effect
the permanent is tapped to pay a non-mana cost

aliases.rule: read the step or phase named after 'at the beginning of'; phase words map to turn.phase.begin

domains.note: who performs the act. Kept distinct from controller (Kate overruled collapsing it).
one_or_more fires once per simultaneous event; each_object once per object
snow is a property of the source (unit.snow), not a colour or type

rules: {C} can be paid only with colorless mana

macros.collect_evidence: exile cards with total mana value N from your graveyard

domains.note: the same act (sacrifice, tap, discard) is either paid as a cost or done on resolution; events of a paid cost are observable before resolution

keyword_macros.expands_to: additional cost {N}; if paid, ETB trigger creates a 1/1 token copy
replacement of a draw: return this card from graveyard to hand and mill N
tap any number of untapped creatures with total power N: becomes an artifact creature (does not make permanent.tapped_for_mana true)
tap another untapped creature: put charge counters equal to its power; sorcery speed
